author: Kate King
title: Looking for artist for two character art pieces
content: I am looking for an artist who has avalibilty right now to draw two pieces of character art. Anyone have an opening? Recs from authors are very welcome. Human artists only, absolutely no AI. Bots and clearly AI content will be blocked. Please only comment below do not DM me. Update: One piece is 2 characters, the other is 3. Will share more info on that privately later as this art is for my new book which is unannounced and I dont want to post too many details publicly. I have no specific style in mind, but would appreciate if you posted an example of your work in the replies. Thank you!! Contact method: comment below only (no DMs). PA will review replies and reach out directly to selected artists.

author: nrfrh_azn
title: Seeking fantasy illustrator for YA novel
content: 🎨 Calling all fantasy illustrators! I’m looking for an illustrator for my upcoming YA fantasy novel. Think dark academia, ancient magic, mysterious towers and an elegant, atmospheric fantasy aesthetic. ✨ If you create fantasy book covers, I’d love to see your portfolio! Please DM me your artwork, rates and estimated turnaround time. Recommendations are welcome too! #FantasyIllustration #BookCoverArtist #YAFantasy Contact: DM portfolio, rates, and turnaround time.

author: maitespena
title: Seeking illustrators for book character promo art
content: 🚨Se buscan ilustradores 📢 Busco quien nos ilustre una serie de personajes, teniendo en cuenta que no todos serán humanos. Son imágenes para redes sociales, para promocionar nuestro libro. No para venderlas ni para ilustrar páginas. Sencillas, de personajes a solas o en grupo (se pedirán varias). Por favor, agradecería que añadierais vuestro portfolio y una lista de precios. También podéis escribirme en privado si lo preferís. Gracias. Update: Todos los personajes son adultos, algunos no humanos (demonios y seres mágicos). Novela adulta con humor. Buscamos estilo sencillo, colorido. Revisaremos todos los portfolios y contactaremos a los interesados. Contact: comment with portfolio and price list, or private message.
